scope: Validate the presence and functionality of new login options (SSO and Passkey) on the VWO login page. The target app (https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/) does not contain these options, so automation cannot be performed against the actual UI.
risks: The target application lacks the SSO and Passkey UI elements, making automated verification impossible.
Any manual verification would require a different environment that implements the new authentication flows.

test_cases.title: UI Visibility of SSO and Passkey buttons
steps: Navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/.
Click the 'Login' link to open the login page.
Observe the login page for buttons labeled 'Sign in using SSO' and 'Sign in with Passkey' positioned below any 'Sign in with Google' button.
test_cases.expected_result: Both 'Sign in using SSO' and 'Sign in with Passkey' buttons are visible and displayed below the 'Sign in with Google' option.
test_cases.reason_if_not: The target app's login page only provides standard username/password fields and does not include SSO or Passkey buttons.

test_cases.title: Successful SSO login flow
steps: Navigate to the login page.
Click the 'Sign in using SSO' button.
Enter valid SSO credentials in the presented SSO provider dialog.
Submit the credentials.
Verify that the user is redirected to the dashboard page.
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated via SSO and lands on the dashboard.
test_cases.reason_if_not: No SSO integration exists in the target application; the button and provider dialog are absent.

test_cases.title: SSO login error handling for invalid credentials
steps: Navigate to the login page.
Click the 'Sign in using SSO' button.
Enter invalid SSO credentials.
Submit the credentials.
Observe the error message displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') is shown and the user remains on the login page.
test_cases.reason_if_not: SSO flow is not implemented in the target app.

test_cases.title: Successful Passkey login flow
steps: Navigate to the login page.
Click the 'Sign in with Passkey' button.
When prompted, select a registered passkey from the browser/device UI.
Confirm the authentication.
Verify redirection to the dashboard.
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged in via Passkey and lands on the dashboard.
test_cases.reason_if_not: Passkey (WebAuthn) login is not present in the target application.

test_cases.title: Passkey fallback when no registered passkey is available
steps: Navigate to the login page.
Click the 'Sign in with Passkey' button.
When the passkey selection dialog shows no registered keys, observe the fallback or guidance message.
test_cases.expected_result: A message guiding the user to register a passkey or use an alternative login method is displayed.
test_cases.reason_if_not: Passkey UI and fallback logic are not implemented in the target app.

test_cases.title: Error handling for unsupported browsers/devices for Passkey
steps: Open the login page using a browser that does not support WebAuthn (e.g., older version of Internet Explorer).
Click the 'Sign in with Passkey' button.
Observe the error or informational message presented.
test_cases.expected_result: A clear message indicating that Passkey login is not supported on the current browser/device is shown.
test_cases.reason_if_not: The target application does not contain Passkey functionality, so this scenario cannot be automated.
